name: industrial-hmi
description: Build the industrial HMI/SCADA runtime rendering capability for nop-chaos-flux: a high-performance canvas scene-graph engine (LeaferJS base + self-developed SCADA semantics layer: point-table data binding, state-driven animations, industrial symbol library, JSON serialization) delivered as the `scada-canvas` renderer in a new package `@nop-chaos/flux-renderers-industrial`. Scope decided 2026-08-03 (docs/discussions/2026-08-03-industrial-hmi-scada-mission-scope-discussion.md): runtime rendering first, editor deferred to a successor mission; dual-track data model (self-contained point table + flux expression bridge); benchmark against LeaferJS official performance tier (numbers officially self-reported, to be calibrated in research phase I0: 100k interactive symbols >=45fps, 10k-point refresh <200ms end-to-end, memory <=320MB @100k symbols). Roadmap fixes 4 independent-agent review gates (post-research / post-design / post-implementation-wave / overall) that may revise direction and prior artifacts, and mandates independent-agent consensus review of all AI-written documents. Research downloads go to ~/sources/industrial-hmi-research/.
